notes.title: Update v1.1.1 available now.
notes.notes:
This minor update changes the following things:
[list]
[*]You can now see the products you need to collect trough walls before the game starts.
[*]Some products should be easier to get.
[*]Removed peas from level 8.
[*]The default framerate limit should now be 60 and not unlimited.
[*]The text on the "same keybindings" no longer overlaps with the buttons.
[*]Improved level achievements implementation.
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who played the game, don't hesitate to give feedback!

Previous update:
[previewyoutube=3CrOPD-ycis;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Big content update AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=3CrOPD-ycis;full][/previewyoutube]
You wanted more difficulty, this should help.
Here is the list of additions and changes that this update brings (v1.1.0).

Major:
[list]
[*]A new store with new product locations
[*]6 new levels (in the new store)
[*]Multiple security guards at the same time in the new levels
[*]Translation of the game into German, Italian and Spanish
[*]Two variations in the new store
[*]The security guards can lo longer spawn in front of the gates
[*]There is now a short period of invincibility after a dash
[*]Best scores are easier to reach
[/list]

Minor:
[list]
[*]The danger effect when the player is near the guard now indicates his direction (left/right) and is more visible
[*]Added and adjusted the tutorial interfaces
[*]Decreased the size of the hitbox of the guards
[*]Added an effect when there are only 15 seconds left
[*]Added an effect to apply graphical settings
[*]Adjusted the names of some products
[*]Added "Level 15" and "Level 18" achievements
[*]Added a new model for pizzas
[*]Fixed a translation error
[*]Shopping carts can no longer appear in obstacles
[*]Adjusted some text boxes
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has and will buy the game!

If you have any questions/feedback/ideas, feel free to contact me!
Twitter : @Glaseeze_
Email : mad.800200900@gmail.com

notes.title: Upcoming content update
notes.notes:
Many players find the game too short and too easy, that's why the next update will have:
[list]
[*]six new levels,
[*]different product locations
[*]and multiple guards at the same time!
[/list]
(the first levels will remain the same)

The last levels will be much more complicated and will require to remember the new locations! Unfortunately, it will take more than a month before the release of this update which requires a lot of work.

The demo should also receive big changes like the accessibility to more than one level and the removal of the wall that limits access to the rest of the store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43277459/68eb586a64190d99193ead30c1880e6862114823.png[/img]

Feel free to post a comment if you want to see other additions to the game!

notes.title: Update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Many players find that the level of the security guards are too high.

[list]
[*]Reduced the difficulty of the first and second security guard.
[*]Adjusted the "play" and "score menu" buttons in the main menu.
[/list]

The level of the last security guard remains the same to keep some of the difficulty and the challenging side of the game.

notes.title: Release date of Sudden Market demo!
notes.notes:
[h2]If you are not sure you want to buy the game you can test the demo![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2217560/Sudden_Market/

[h1]Demo specifications:[/h1]

[list][*]One single level unique to the demo that can be replayed over and over again.
[*]The score menu* is available for the demo level.
[*]An in-game tutorial.
[*]The demo has an easier variation of the intermediate security guard.
[*]A part of the supermarket is unreachable, unlock it by purchasing the game.[/list]
*This menu allows you to evaluate your score based on your best time.

The demo will be released on the [u][b]19th of December, 2022 at 2PM CET[/b][/u], 5AM PST.

[h3]If you enjoy it, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist![/h3]
